answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 18 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the crystal solution is checked at the river gate and logged, the oasis audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The fee repeats 22 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
